---
title: Path payments
description: Send a payment where the asset received differs from the asset sent.
---

In a path payment, the asset received differs from the asset sent. Rather than the operation transferring assets directly from one account to another, path payments cross through the SDEX and/or liquidity pools before arriving at the destination account. For the path payment to succeed, there has to be a DEX offer or liquidity pool exchange path in existence. It can sometimes take several hops of conversion to succeed.

For example:

Account A sells XLM → [buy XLM / sell ETH → buy ETH / sell BTC → buy BTC / sell USDC] → Account B receives USDC

It is possible for path payments to fail if there are no viable exchange paths.

For more information on the Stellar Decentralized Exchange and Liquidity Pools, see the [Liquidity on Stellar section](../../../learn/fundamentals/liquidity-on-stellar-sdex-liquidity-pools).

## Operations

Path payments use the Path Payment Strict Send or Path Payment Strict Receive operations.

### Path Payment Strict Send

Allows a user to specify the amount of the asset to send. The amount received will vary based on offers in the order books and/or liquidity pools.

### Path Payment Strict Receive

Allows a user to specify the amount of the asset received. The amount sent will vary based on the offers in the order books/liquidity pools.

## Path payments - more info {#path-payments---more-info}

- Path payments don’t allow intermediate offers to be from the source account as this would yield a worse exchange rate. You’ll need to either split the path payment into two smaller path payments or ensure that the source account’s offers are not at the top of the order book.
- Balances are settled at the very end of the operation.
  - This is especially important when (`Destination, Destination Asset) == (Source, Send Asset`) as this provides a functionality equivalent to getting a no-interest loan for the duration of the operation.
- `Destination min` is a protective measure, it allows you to specify a lower bound for an acceptable conversion. If offers in the order books are not favorable enough for the operation to deliver that amount, the operation will fail.

## Example

First, ensure the receiver has a trustline established for the asset they will receive. In this example, we will use USDC as the asset received. The sender will send XLM, which will be converted to USDC through the path payment operation.

<CodeGroup>

```js JavaScript
import {
  Horizon,
  Asset,
  Keypair,
  TransactionBuilder,
  Networks,
  Operation,
  Memo,
} from "@stellar/stellar-sdk";

const USDC_ISSUER = "GBBD47IF6LWK7P7MDEVSCWR7DPUWV3NY3DTQEVFL4NAT4AQH3ZLLFLA5"; // USDC issuer on Stellar Testnet
const USDC_ASSET = new Asset("USDC", USDC_ISSUER); // USDC asset on Stellar Testnet
const RECEIVER_SECRET = "S..."; // Receiver's secret key

const SENDER_SECRET = "S..."; // Sender's secret key
const horizonServer = new Horizon.Server("https://horizon-testnet.stellar.org");

// Bid what recent transactions paid, capped at what you're willing to spend.
const { fee_charged } = await horizonServer.feeStats();
const MAX_FEE = 100_000; // stroops per operation (0.01 XLM): pick your own cap
const fee = String(Math.min(Number(fee_charged.p90), MAX_FEE));

// Create a USDC trustline for the receiver
const receiverKP = Keypair.fromSecret(RECEIVER_SECRET);
let account = await horizonServer.loadAccount(receiverKP.publicKey());
let transaction = new TransactionBuilder(account, {
  fee,
  networkPassphrase: Networks.TESTNET,
})
  .addOperation(
    Operation.changeTrust({
      asset: USDC_ASSET,
      limit: "10",
    }),
  )
  .addMemo(Memo.text("Trusting USDC"))
  .setTimeout(30)
  .build();

transaction.sign(receiverKP);
let resp = await horizonServer.submitTransaction(transaction);
console.log("resp", resp);
```

```python Python
from stellar_sdk import Asset, Keypair, Network, Server, TransactionBuilder

# USDC issuer on Stellar Testnet
USDC_ISSUER = "GBBD47IF6LWK7P7MDEVSCWR7DPUWV3NY3DTQEVFL4NAT4AQH3ZLLFLA5"
USDC_ASSET = Asset("USDC", USDC_ISSUER)  # USDC asset on Stellar Testnet
RECEIVER_SECRET = "S..."  # Receiver's secret key

SENDER_SECRET = "S..."  # Sender's secret key
horizon_server = Server("https://horizon-testnet.stellar.org")

# Bid what recent transactions paid, capped at what you're willing to spend.
fee_charged = horizon_server.fee_stats().call()["fee_charged"]
MAX_FEE = 100_000  # stroops per operation (0.01 XLM): pick your own cap
fee = min(int(fee_charged["p90"]), MAX_FEE)

# Create a USDC trustline for the receiver
receiver_kp = Keypair.from_secret(RECEIVER_SECRET)
account = horizon_server.load_account(receiver_kp.public_key)
transaction = (
    TransactionBuilder(
        source_account=account,
        network_passphrase=Network.TESTNET_NETWORK_PASSPHRASE,
        base_fee=fee,
    )
    .append_change_trust_op(asset=USDC_ASSET, limit="10")
    .add_text_memo("Trusting USDC")
    .set_timeout(30)
    .build()
)

transaction.sign(receiver_kp)
resp = horizon_server.submit_transaction(transaction)
print("resp", resp)
```

```go Go
package main

import (
  "log"

  "github.com/stellar/go-stellar-sdk/clients/horizonclient"
  "github.com/stellar/go-stellar-sdk/keypair"
  "github.com/stellar/go-stellar-sdk/network"
  "github.com/stellar/go-stellar-sdk/txnbuild"
)

const usdcIssuer = "GBBD47IF6LWK7P7MDEVSCWR7DPUWV3NY3DTQEVFL4NAT4AQH3ZLLFLA5" // USDC issuer on Stellar Testnet
const receiverSecret = "S..."                                                  // Receiver's secret key
const senderSecret = "S..."                                                    // Sender's secret key

var usdcAsset = txnbuild.CreditAsset{Code: "USDC", Issuer: usdcIssuer} // USDC asset on Stellar Testnet
var horizonServer = horizonclient.DefaultTestNetClient

func main() {
  // Bid what recent transactions paid, capped at what you're willing to spend.
  feeStats, err := horizonServer.FeeStats()
  check(err)
  const maxFee = 100_000 // stroops per operation (0.01 XLM): pick your own cap
  fee := min(feeStats.FeeCharged.P90, maxFee)

  // Create a USDC trustline for the receiver
  receiverKP := keypair.MustParseFull(receiverSecret)
  account, err := horizonServer.AccountDetail(horizonclient.AccountRequest{AccountID: receiverKP.Address()})
  check(err)
  transaction, err := txnbuild.NewTransaction(txnbuild.TransactionParams{
    SourceAccount:        &account,
    IncrementSequenceNum: true,
    BaseFee:              fee,
    Memo:                 txnbuild.MemoText("Trusting USDC"),
    Preconditions:        txnbuild.Preconditions{TimeBounds: txnbuild.NewTimeout(30)},
    Operations: []txnbuild.Operation{
      &txnbuild.ChangeTrust{
        Line:  usdcAsset.MustToChangeTrustAsset(),
        Limit: "10",
      },
    },
  })
  check(err)

  transaction, err = transaction.Sign(network.TestNetworkPassphrase, receiverKP)
  check(err)
  resp, err := horizonServer.SubmitTransaction(transaction)
  check(err)
  log.Printf("resp %+v", resp)

  // The next step defines sendPathPayment.
  sendPathPayment(fee, receiverKP)
}

func check(err error) {
  if err != nil {
    log.Fatal(err)
  }
}
```

</CodeGroup>

Now let's send a path payment from the sender to the receiver, converting XLM to USDC.

<CodeGroup>

```js JavaScript
// Use path payment to send XLM from the receiver to the sender, who receives USDC
let senderKP = Keypair.fromSecret(SENDER_SECRET);
account = await horizonServer.loadAccount(senderKP.publicKey());
transaction = new TransactionBuilder(account, {
  fee,
  networkPassphrase: Networks.TESTNET,
})
  .addOperation(
    Operation.pathPaymentStrictReceive({
      sendAsset: Asset.native(), // Sending XLM
      sendMax: "10", // Maximum amount of XLM to send
      destAsset: USDC_ASSET, // Receiving USDC
      destAmount: "1", // Amount of USDC to receive
      destination: receiverKP.publicKey(), // Receiver's public key
    }),
  )
  .addMemo(Memo.text("XLM to USDC"))
  .setTimeout(30)
  .build();

transaction.sign(senderKP);
resp = await horizonServer.submitTransaction(transaction);
console.log("resp", resp);
```

```python Python
# Use path payment to send XLM from the receiver to the sender, who receives USDC
sender_kp = Keypair.from_secret(SENDER_SECRET)
account = horizon_server.load_account(sender_kp.public_key)
transaction = (
    TransactionBuilder(
        source_account=account,
        network_passphrase=Network.TESTNET_NETWORK_PASSPHRASE,
        base_fee=fee,
    )
    .append_path_payment_strict_receive_op(
        destination=receiver_kp.public_key,  # Receiver's public key
        send_asset=Asset.native(),  # Sending XLM
        send_max="10",  # Maximum amount of XLM to send
        dest_asset=USDC_ASSET,  # Receiving USDC
        dest_amount="1",  # Amount of USDC to receive
        path=[],  # No intermediate assets: XLM converts straight to USDC
    )
    .add_text_memo("XLM to USDC")
    .set_timeout(30)
    .build()
)

transaction.sign(sender_kp)
resp = horizon_server.submit_transaction(transaction)
print("resp", resp)
```

```go Go
// Use path payment to send XLM from the sender to the receiver, who receives USDC
func sendPathPayment(fee int64, receiverKP *keypair.Full) {
  senderKP := keypair.MustParseFull(senderSecret)
  account, err := horizonServer.AccountDetail(horizonclient.AccountRequest{AccountID: senderKP.Address()})
  check(err)
  transaction, err := txnbuild.NewTransaction(txnbuild.TransactionParams{
    SourceAccount:        &account,
    IncrementSequenceNum: true,
    BaseFee:              fee,
    Memo:                 txnbuild.MemoText("XLM to USDC"),
    Preconditions:        txnbuild.Preconditions{TimeBounds: txnbuild.NewTimeout(30)},
    Operations: []txnbuild.Operation{
      &txnbuild.PathPaymentStrictReceive{
        SendAsset:   txnbuild.NativeAsset{}, // Sending XLM
        SendMax:     "10",                   // Maximum amount of XLM to send
        DestAsset:   usdcAsset,              // Receiving USDC
        DestAmount:  "1",                    // Amount of USDC to receive
        Destination: receiverKP.Address(),   // Receiver's public key
        Path:        []txnbuild.Asset{},     // No intermediate assets: XLM converts straight to USDC
      },
    },
  })
  check(err)

  transaction, err = transaction.Sign(network.TestNetworkPassphrase, senderKP)
  check(err)
  resp, err := horizonServer.SubmitTransaction(transaction)
  check(err)
  log.Printf("resp %+v", resp)
}
```

</CodeGroup>
